basics.name: 황우성 (Woosung Hwang)
basics.label: Machine Learning Engineer
basics.summary: 카카오에서 추천, 광고, QA, 요약, 장소 추천 등 다양한 도메인의 production ML/LLM 시스템을 개발했습니다. 최근에는 LLM fine-tuning, model routing, RAG, tool/function calling, 평가 자동화, vLLM 기반 서빙처럼 실제 서비스 품질과 비용에 직접 영향을 주는 문제에 집중하고 있습니다. 빠르게 변하는 연구 흐름을 서비스 문제로 번역하고, 데이터 기반 실험으로 개선 폭을 확인하는 일을 좋아합니다.

work.name: Kakao
work.summary: LLM Alignment Team and Recommendation Team. Worked on LLM applications, recommendation systems, keyword ads, QA, summarization, and place recommendation.
highlights: Developed LLM-based services including place recommendation, KBO game summarization, QA chatbots, model routing, and domain-specific fine-tuned models.
Led cost-aware LLM router development, reducing LLM operating cost by about 60% while retaining 99% of GPT-4o-level quality in the target scenario.
Built keyword ads ranking and matching improvements that increased ad CTR by 4% in online A/B tests and contributed about KRW 700M in annual incremental revenue.
Applied bandit-based personalized recommendation to KakaoTalk Viewtab and Piccoma, improving CTR by up to 5.27% across several content domains.
Designed data pipelines, evaluation metrics, and serving workflows with Kafka, PySpark, Airflow, Kubernetes, RAG, vLLM, and model fine-tuning frameworks.

work.name: Kakao
work.summary: Recommendation Team internship focused on Piccoma webtoon recommendation algorithm optimization.
highlights: Improved a Random Walk with Restart based TPA recommendation logic for Piccoma webtoon recommendation.
Applied Alias Method, parallel processing with numba/cupy, and graph pruning to reduce sequence similarity matching cost.
Achieved more than 2x response speed improvement and about 50% memory reduction, with CTR improvement after production deployment.
Published an internship retrospective on the Kakao Tech Blog.

courses: Thesis: Efficient Data Sequence Matching Using Index Structures
Researched sequence matching methods for monotonic data domains and efficient similarity search.
Graduated with highest honors, GPA above 4.0 / 4.3.
Worked on dimensionality reduction for time-series data and optimal precoder selection for MIMO systems.

projects.name: LLM-based Place Recommendation Model
projects.summary: Developed an in-house LLM for conversational place recommendation on KakaoMap, focusing on user intent understanding, tool/function calling, and recommendation quality.
highlights: Built synthetic and refined training datasets reflecting real user search patterns and place recommendation intents.
Fine-tuned in-house LLMs to improve tool-call accuracy and place recommendation quality.
Developed a lightweight rerank model trained with GRPO to order retrieved places by user preference and dialogue context.
Explored large-scale GRPO training with Verl, Axolotl, Megatron-LM, Slurm, and multi-node distributed training.
Verified that a relatively lightweight 12B model could approach GPT-4.1 API-level performance in the target workflow, while improving inference speed.

projects.name: Cost-aware LLM Router
projects.summary: Led development of an LLM routing system that selects the most cost-effective model for each user query while maintaining service quality.
highlights: Led a four-person development team, including system architecture, roadmap planning, and sprint execution.
Designed router evaluation metrics and an evaluation pipeline.
Generated router tuning data using Instruction Evolution and Magpie-style strategies.
Introduced Prompt Compression and model routing to reduce LLM operating cost by about 60%.
Maintained 99% of existing GPT-4o performance in the target scenario and presented the model orchestration case at if(kakao) 2024 CEO Keynote.

projects.name: KBO Baseball Bot Summarization Service
projects.summary: Led LLM development for KakaoTalk Pro Baseball Bot, delivering game summaries, live cheer analysis, and short-form summaries.
highlights: Developed GPT-based prompt engineering prototypes and production summarization logic for KBO game content.
Built evaluation pipelines for iterative prompt and model improvements.
Secured high-quality training data through synthetic data generation and collaboration with labeling teams.
Served models with vLLM and proposed patches to prevent unwanted Chinese responses.
Achieved 61% human preference over GPT-4-Turbo for KBO game summaries; channel metrics improved with MAU +52% and friends +40% year over year.

projects.name: Domain QA LLM and RAG System
projects.summary: Built domain-specific QA models and RAG pipelines for high-traffic chatbot scenarios using open-source LLMs and retrieval systems.
highlights: Designed a two-stage lightweight open-source LLM architecture for production QA.
Built RAG systems combining BM25 and vector search, and evaluated them with RAGAS, ROUGE, partial matching, and TruthfulQA-inspired hallucination metrics.
Fine-tuned embedding models with small domain datasets, improving retrieval quality by up to 30% in RAGAS-based evaluation.
Led human labeling guidelines and data collection tooling for high-quality QA training data.
Demonstrated Llama 2 based QA quality comparable to GPT-3.5-turbo in the target medical-domain evaluation setting.

projects.name: Keyword Ads Recommendation and Matching
projects.summary: Improved Daum Search keyword ad ranking and matching logic by combining expected revenue prediction, CTR modeling, and embedding-based query-ad matching.
highlights: Compared LR, DNN, FM, and GBRT for ad CTR prediction; FM improved offline AUC by about 12%.
Improved online ad CTR by 4% in A/B tests.
Expanded ad exposure coverage from 35% to 64% in offline experiments.
Designed distributed ANN search over about 10M ad units using Word2Vec and BERT embeddings.
Contributed to about KRW 700M in annual incremental revenue from improved ad exposure logic, with further upside from expanded logic coverage.

projects.name: Bandit-based Personalized Recommendation Platform
projects.summary: Developed and operated bandit-based personalized recommendation systems for KakaoTalk Viewtab, Piccoma, and other content domains.
highlights: Built Kafka-based real-time data pipelines to use user behavior as learning data.
Improved CTR by up to 5.27% across domains such as news and entertainment.
Introduced cold-start recommendation logic, improving new-user conversion by about 3%.
Refactored Sanic serving APIs and training modules to reduce I/O load and memory usage.
Deployed and operated recommendation services in Kubernetes-based clusters.
